"""Approved frozen 494-day industry runless registration; default read-only."""
import argparse
import hashlib
import json
import os
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from pathlib import Path

import dagster as dg
from dagster._core.definitions.run_request import InstigatorType
from dagster_postgres import PostgresScheduleStorage
from orchestrator.defs.asset_guards.moneyflow_ind_ths_readiness import batch_industry_moneyflow_ths_readiness
from orchestrator.defs.bootstrap.daily_basic_event_instance import INSTANCE_HOME, daily_basic_event_instance
from orchestrator.defs.bootstrap.moneyflow_history_event_preview import read_moneyflow_event_state
from orchestrator.defs.bootstrap.moneyflow_ind_ths_events import report_industry_moneyflow_ths_history_events
from orchestrator.defs.run_contracts.moneyflow_automation import INDUSTRY_THS_MONEYFLOW_AUTOMATION as CONTRACT
from orchestrator.defs.sensors import moneyflow_ind_ths_sensor as sensor_definitions

parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
parser.add_argument('--apply', action='store_true')
args = parser.parse_args()
ROOT = Path('/Users/congming/github/goldenshare')
BASE = ROOT / 'lake_console/reports'
FULL_HASH = '7dbc2c4f08774552f6f0fafa8f423338980d53fb262a300ce09506e4a1cbdc1c'
ACCEPTED = json.loads((BASE / 'moneyflow_p4_ind_ths_event_registration_evidence_20261010.json').read_text())
plan = json.loads((BASE / 'moneyflow_p4_ind_ths_event_registration_full_plan_20261010.json').read_text())
full = json.loads((BASE / 'moneyflow_p4_ind_ths_event_registration_full_plan_20261010.json').read_text())
assert plan['plan_hash'] == full['plan_hash'] == FULL_HASH
assert plan['dataset'] == full['dataset'] == 'moneyflow_ind_ths'
assert len(plan['entries']) == 494 and plan['entries'][0]['day'] == '2024-09-10' and plan['entries'][-1]['day'] == '2026-09-30'
assert sum(e['row_count'] for e in plan['entries']) == 44460
assert plan['total_work_items'] == 1522 and len(plan['recent_check_dates']) == 20
assert INSTANCE_HOME == Path('/Users/congming/.goldenshare/dagster_home')
assert subprocess.check_output(['git', 'branch', '--show-current'], cwd=ROOT, text=True).strip() == 'dev-interface'
assert subprocess.check_output(['git', 'rev-parse', '--short=8', 'HEAD'], cwd=ROOT, text=True).strip() == '5e705f45'

def sha(path):
    return hashlib.sha256(Path(path).read_bytes()).hexdigest()

for relative, digest in ACCEPTED['current_python_sha256'].items():
    assert sha(ROOT / relative) == digest, relative
for p in ACCEPTED['formal_read_only_plans']['industry_plans'].values():
    assert sha(ROOT / p['path']) == p['file_sha256']
lake, staging = Path(plan['lake_root']), Path(plan['staging_root'])
assert lake == Path('/Volumes/datasource/data_lake')
assert staging == Path('/Volumes/datasource/data_lake_staging')
assert lake.is_dir() and staging.is_dir() and (staging / 'moneyflow/history-full-20261009').is_dir()
assert not any(p.is_symlink() for p in (lake, staging))
assert lake.stat().st_dev == staging.stat().st_dev
capacity = shutil.disk_usage(staging)
assert capacity.free > 32 * 1024 * 1024
assert os.access(staging / 'moneyflow/history-full-20261009', os.W_OK)
NAMES = {
    'cn_a_moneyflow_ind_ths_trade_day_sensor',
    'raw_tushare_moneyflow_ind_ths_update_job_sensor',
    'silver_moneyflow_ind_ths_update_job_sensor',
}
assert all(getattr(sensor_definitions, n).default_status == dg.DefaultSensorStatus.STOPPED for n in NAMES)

def sensors(instance):
    storage = PostgresScheduleStorage(instance.event_log_storage.postgres_url, should_autocreate_tables=False)
    try:
        records = storage.all_instigator_state(instigator_type=InstigatorType.SENSOR)
        assert len(records) <= 2000
        relevant = [s for s in records if s.name in NAMES]
        assert all(s.status.value in {'STOPPED', 'DECLARED_IN_CODE'} for s in relevant), 'active industry sensor'
        return {
            'metadata_query': 'native all_instigator_state SENSOR',
            'sensor_records_scanned': len(records),
            'matching_states': [{'name': s.name, 'status': s.status.value} for s in relevant],
            'absent_names': sorted(NAMES - {s.name for s in relevant}),
            'code_default_status': 'STOPPED (three current imported definitions)',
            'mutation_count': 0,
        }
    finally:
        storage.dispose()

def event_summary(instance):
    actual = read_moneyflow_event_state(instance, plan['entries'], plan['recent_check_dates'], contract=CONTRACT)
    counts = {e['day']: e['row_count'] for e in plan['entries']}
    mats = []
    checks = []
    for (day, layer), record in sorted(actual['mats'].items()):
        md = record.asset_materialization.metadata
        assert md['dagster/row_count'].value == md['goldenshare/source_row_count'].value == counts[day]
        mats.append({'date': day, 'layer': layer, 'storage_id': record.storage_id,
            'run_id': record.event_log_entry.run_id, 'timestamp': record.timestamp,
            'row_count': md['dagster/row_count'].value,
            'source_row_count': md['goldenshare/source_row_count'].value,
            'file_sha256': md['goldenshare/file_sha256'].value,
            'raw_sha256': md['goldenshare/raw_sha256'].value if layer == 'silver' else None})
    for (day, layer), record in sorted(actual['checks'].items()):
        evaluation = record.event.dagster_event.event_specific_data
        target = evaluation.target_materialization_data
        mat = actual['mats'][(day, layer)]
        assert evaluation.metadata['goldenshare/checked_row_count'].value == counts[day]
        assert evaluation.partition == record.partition == day
        assert target.storage_id == mat.storage_id and target.run_id == mat.event_log_entry.run_id and target.timestamp == mat.timestamp
        checks.append({'date': day, 'layer': layer, 'status': record.status.value,
            'partition': record.partition, 'checked_row_count': evaluation.metadata['goldenshare/checked_row_count'].value,
            'passed': evaluation.passed, 'blocking': evaluation.blocking,
            'target': {'storage_id': target.storage_id, 'run_id': target.run_id, 'timestamp': target.timestamp},
            'materialization_target_matches': True})
    return {'registered_keys_in_scope': len(set(counts) & actual['registered']),
        'registered_scope_keys': sorted(set(counts) & actual['registered']),
        'all_industry_registered_key_count': len(actual['registered']),
        'materializations': mats, 'checks': checks}

result = {'as_of_utc': datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
    'mode': 'approved_full_apply' if args.apply else 'read_only_preflight',
    'authorization': 'User: 提交吧。然后继续推进; previous response and LLD 37.2 identified exact frozen full industry manifest as next stage',
    'implementation_commit': '5e705f45', 'instance_home': str(INSTANCE_HOME),
    'plan_hash': FULL_HASH, 'full_plan_hash': FULL_HASH,
    'staging_free_bytes': capacity.free, 'lake_device': lake.stat().st_dev, 'staging_device': staging.stat().st_dev,
    'accepted_source_hashes': ACCEPTED['current_python_sha256'],
    'runtime_execution': 'fresh Python process imports current committed adapter/shared engine; not a code-location job or sensor evaluation',
    'formal_writes': {'partition_keys': 0, 'materializations': 0, 'checks': 0},
    'unexecuted': ['Parquet writes', 'Prod/Tushare requests', 'reload', 'sensor state/evaluation', 'pool configuration', 'jobs'],
}
out = Path('/private/tmp/moneyflow-p4-ind-ths-formal-full-' + ('apply' if args.apply else 'preflight') + '-20261011.json')
try:
    with daily_basic_event_instance() as instance:
        result['sensor_preflight'] = sensors(instance)
        result['preflight'] = report_industry_moneyflow_ths_history_events(instance=instance, plan=plan)
        result['before_events'] = event_summary(instance)
    if args.apply:
        assert result['preflight']['missing_partition_keys'] == 492 and result['preflight']['completed'] == 10
        assert result['preflight']['missing_materializations'] == 984 and result['preflight']['missing_checks'] == 36
        with daily_basic_event_instance() as instance:
            result['sensor_before_apply'] = sensors(instance)
        progress = []
        def observe(item):
            progress.append(item)
            result['last_progress'] = item
            print(json.dumps({'progress': item}, ensure_ascii=False), flush=True)
        with daily_basic_event_instance(writable=True) as instance:
            result['apply'] = report_industry_moneyflow_ths_history_events(instance=instance, plan=plan, apply=True, progress=observe)
        assert result['apply']['stage'] == 'complete' and result['apply']['completed'] == 1522
        assert result['apply']['written_events_this_attempt'] == 1020 and result['apply']['registered_keys_this_attempt'] == 492
        result['progress_records'] = len(progress)
        assert [p['completed'] for p in progress] == sorted(p['completed'] for p in progress)
        result['formal_writes'] = {'partition_keys': 492, 'materializations': 984, 'checks': 36}
        with daily_basic_event_instance() as instance:
            result['postflight'] = report_industry_moneyflow_ths_history_events(instance=instance, plan=plan)
            result['full_remaining'] = result['postflight']
            result['after_events'] = event_summary(instance)
            ready = {'raw': {}, 'silver': {}}
            for offset in (0, 10):
                batch = batch_industry_moneyflow_ths_readiness(instance, lake, plan['recent_check_dates'][offset:offset+10])
                for layer, days in batch.items():
                    ready[layer].update(days)
            result['readiness'] = {layer: {day: {'ready': value.ready, 'reason': value.reason} for day, value in days.items()} for layer, days in ready.items()}
            assert all(value.ready for days in ready.values() for value in days.values())
            result['sensor_postflight'] = sensors(instance)
        assert all(result['postflight'][k] == 0 for k in ('missing_partition_keys', 'missing_materializations', 'missing_checks'))
        assert result['full_remaining']['missing_partition_keys'] == 0
        assert result['full_remaining']['missing_materializations'] == result['full_remaining']['missing_checks'] == 0
        assert result['full_remaining']['completed'] == 1522
        checkpoint = staging / 'moneyflow/history-full-20261009/events' / FULL_HASH / 'checkpoint.json'
        result['checkpoint_path'] = str(checkpoint)
        result['checkpoint_state'] = json.loads(checkpoint.read_text())
        assert result['checkpoint_state']['stage'] == 'complete' and result['checkpoint_state']['completed'] == 1522
        assert result['after_events']['registered_keys_in_scope'] == 494
        assert len(result['after_events']['materializations']) == 988 and len(result['after_events']['checks']) == 40
        sample = json.loads((BASE / 'moneyflow_p4_ind_ths_event_registration_formal_sample_evidence_20261011.json').read_text())
        ids = {(m['date'], m['layer']): m['storage_id'] for m in result['after_events']['materializations']}
        assert all(ids[(m['date'], m['layer'])] == m['storage_id'] for m in sample['formal_result']['after_events']['materializations'])
        result['sample_materializations_reused'] = True
    result['controls_unchanged'] = all(sha(p) == digest for p, digest in plan['controls'].items())
    assert result['controls_unchanged']
    result['runtime_loaded_project_sources'] = {
        str(Path(module.__file__).relative_to(ROOT)): sha(module.__file__)
        for module in list(sys.modules.values())
        if getattr(module, '__file__', None) and str(module.__file__).startswith(str(ROOT / 'lake_console/orchestrator/src/')) and str(module.__file__).endswith('.py')
    }
    result['passed'] = True
except BaseException as error:
    result['passed'] = False
    result['error'] = {'type': type(error).__name__, 'message': str(error)}
    raise
finally:
    result['finished_at_utc'] = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
    out.write_text(json.dumps(result, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + '\n')
    print(json.dumps({'result_file': str(out), 'passed': result.get('passed'), 'result': result.get('apply', result.get('preflight')), 'readiness': result.get('readiness'), 'formal_writes': result['formal_writes']}, ensure_ascii=False))

"""Read-only formal definition and pool admission inventory; no mutation."""
import json
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from pathlib import Path
from urllib.request import Request, urlopen
from orchestrator.defs.bootstrap.daily_basic_event_instance import daily_basic_event_instance
query = '''query MoneyflowAdmission { workspaceOrError { __typename ... on Workspace { locationEntries { name loadStatus updatedTimestamp locationOrLoadError { __typename ... on RepositoryLocation { repositories { name jobs { name } sensors { name defaultStatus sensorState { status } } } } } } } } }'''
result = {'as_of_utc': datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(), 'formal_writes': 0, 'graphql_query': query, 'endpoint': 'http://127.0.0.1:3000/graphql'}
from sqlalchemy import select, func
from dagster._core.storage.event_log.schema import ConcurrencyLimitsTable, ConcurrencySlotsTable, PendingStepsTable
with daily_basic_event_instance() as instance:
    with instance.event_log_storage.index_connection() as connection:
        limit = connection.execute(select(ConcurrencyLimitsTable.c.limit, ConcurrencyLimitsTable.c.using_default_limit).where(ConcurrencyLimitsTable.c.concurrency_key == 'moneyflow_tushare_writer')).fetchone()
        slots = connection.execute(select(func.count()).select_from(ConcurrencySlotsTable).where(ConcurrencySlotsTable.c.concurrency_key == 'moneyflow_tushare_writer', ConcurrencySlotsTable.c.deleted == False)).scalar_one()
        pending = connection.execute(select(func.count()).select_from(PendingStepsTable).where(PendingStepsTable.c.concurrency_key == 'moneyflow_tushare_writer')).scalar_one()
    result['pool'] = {'name': 'moneyflow_tushare_writer', 'persisted_limit': limit[0] if limit else None, 'using_default_limit': limit[1] if limit else None, 'slot_count': slots, 'pending_records': pending, 'native_metadata_queries': 3}
result['pool_api_note'] = 'Original read-only event adapter intentionally has no run coordinator. Native get_concurrency_info requires coordinator when limit is absent; use three bounded native table reads, do not construct or configure a new instance.'
request = Request(result['endpoint'], data=json.dumps({'query': query}).encode(), headers={'Content-Type': 'application/json'})
try:
    with urlopen(request, timeout=10) as response:
        payload = response.read(2 * 1024 * 1024 + 1)
        assert len(payload) <= 2 * 1024 * 1024
    inventory = json.loads(payload)
    assert not inventory.get('errors'), inventory.get('errors')
    workspace = inventory['data']['workspaceOrError']
    result['workspace_type'] = workspace['__typename']
    result['locations'] = []
    for location in workspace.get('locationEntries', []):
        assert len(workspace['locationEntries']) <= 20
        repositories = location['locationOrLoadError'].get('repositories', [])
        item = {k: location[k] for k in ('name', 'loadStatus', 'updatedTimestamp')}
        item['repositories'] = []
        for repository in repositories:
            assert len(repository['jobs']) <= 2000 and len(repository['sensors']) <= 2000
            item['repositories'].append({'name': repository['name'], 'jobs_count': len(repository['jobs']), 'sensors_count': len(repository['sensors']), 'moneyflow_jobs': [j for j in repository['jobs'] if 'moneyflow_ind_ths' in j['name']], 'moneyflow_sensors': [s for s in repository['sensors'] if 'moneyflow_ind_ths' in s['name']]})
        result['locations'].append(item)
except Exception as error:
    result['workspace_read_error'] = type(error).__name__ + ': ' + str(error)
Path('/private/tmp/moneyflow-p4-ind-ths-next-admission-20261011.json').write_text(json.dumps(result, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps(result, ensure_ascii=False))
